# Adeept PiCar-B Attribution

## Known source record

Existing vendor documentation names the package as `ADR012-V5.1_PiCar-B_MarsRover_SmartCarKit_for_RPi-20260407`, supplied with the Adeept PiCar-B platform. The copied folder contains selected example programs for motors, servos, LEDs, buzzer, ultrasonic sensing, line tracking and battery monitoring.
